rules.rule: a runbook with no step in one of the 5 required phases (backup, switch, verify, rollback and hypercare)
a migrate-data or switch step that names no rollback step, names one that is not in the runbook, or names a step outside the rollback phase
a migrate-data step that depends on no other migrate-data step and on no backup step, directly or through others
a first switch step with no go/no-go gate among the steps it depends on, directly or through others
a step whose depends-on names an id that no step has
steps that depend on each other, directly or through others, so that no order can run them
a step whose id an earlier step has
a critical path over the steps of the freeze, backup, migrate-data, switch and verify phases longer than the downtime window
rollback steps whose durations add up to more than the downtime window less the critical path
a runbook of a retired application with migrate-data steps, or of a retained application with switch steps
an application with no name, no migration strategy or no downtime window
an application with no business sign-off person
an application with no data owner
an application whose communication plan is no or not given
a field of a step or of the application that the tool cannot read
a runbook or application file that the tool could not read as UTF-8 or UTF-16 text
a runbook or application file that the CSV or JSON reader refuses
